biotools.summary: Genome Continuity Inspector (GCI) is a tool designed to assess genome assembly continuity at single-base resolution, providing a standard for evaluating T2T genome assemblies. It utilizes long-read mapping and curated coverage to identify and quantify assembly issues.
biotools.name: Genome Continuity Inspector (GCI)
